messages:
maya: Heads up: someone labeled a jar in the fridge 'DO NOT OPEN' and of course i opened it. it is full of tiny pickles. tiny, opinionated pickles. :pickle:

lou: omg same. we call them 'gherkin interns' now. they have strong takes on snacking etiquette

eli: who even brings tiny pickles to the office?? mystery and chaos, the two pillars of free snacks

zoe: i left a sticky note that said 'estate of tiny pickles' next to them. if unclaimed by friday they go to the lobby plant

kitchen-bot: Note: Please label personal food with name and date. Unlabeled items will be moved to 'Community Snacks' after 72 hours. 12:00 PM kitchen-bot

maya: suggestion: next time put them in a tiny coffin so the mystery is preserved and also spooky

lou: poll: should we adopt a mascot for the jar? options: Gherky, Sir Crunch, or The Brine Whisperer. reply Gherky/SirCrunch/Whisperer

eli: Gherky forever

zoe: Whisperer is hauntingly accurate

maya: fine. team Gherky. meeting adjourned. :tada:
